description: List comments on a Zendesk ticket, including available author, content and attachment details. Supports sort order, page size and inclusion of inline images; comment body fields may be absent.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing comments on a Zendesk ticket.

include.description: Accepts 'users'. Use this parameter to list email CCs by side-loading users. Example: `?include=users`. Note: If the comment source is email, a deleted user will be represented as the CC'd email address. If the comment source is anything else, a deleted user will be represented as the user name.
include.human_parameter_description: Enter 'users' to include user information (such as email CCs) side-loaded with the comments.
include.title: Include

include_inline_images.description: When true, inline images are also listed as attachments in the response. Defaults to false.
include_inline_images.human_parameter_description: Set to true to include inline images as attachments in the response.
include_inline_images.title: Include Inline Images

per_page.description: Number of records to return per page (max 100).
per_page.human_parameter_description: How many comments to show per page. You can choose up to 100.
per_page.title: Per Page

sort_order.description: Sort order for comments. Defaults to 'asc' (oldest first). Use 'desc' for newest first.
sort_order.human_parameter_description: Choose 'asc' to see oldest comments first, or 'desc' to see newest comments first.
sort_order.title: Sort Order

ticket_id.description: The ID of the ticket to retrieve comments for.
ticket_id.human_parameter_description: The unique identifier of the Zendesk ticket. You can find this ID in the ticket URL or from a ticket list.
ticket_id.title: Ticket Id
